Sasha (PM): Heads-up — we need to rebalance the Optimize toolkit roadmap: batching, prefix caching, quant recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Three customer drivers: lower token cost, <100ms P95 for mobile, fast detection of regressions. I sketched 3 lanes: Cost, Latency/Reliability, Quality. Need prioritized gates by EOW. Thoughts?

Mike (Eng): +1. Split batching: server-side dynamic batching (infra) vs mobile heuristics. Dynamic gives bigger wins but higher risk.

Linda (ML): For quant, we should start with model profiles (fp16, q4, int8) + per-model baselines. Llama2 and top-2 community models first. Need eval harness before rollout.

Anna (Solutions): Customers want a simple "cost vs latency" slider in Console and a migration checklist for Dedicated. Also short example runbooks for solutions engineers.

Tom (SRE): Warning: aggressive batching can spike P99. Require canary, per-route heatmaps, token-level cost metrics, and circuit-breaker SLOs. Define rollback triggers.

Sasha (PM): Draft minimal launch gates: 1) Quant perf matrix for top-3 models; 2) Batching policy with SLO override + canary; 3) Eval-alerts prototype + sample policies/runbook; 4) Console "cost vs latency" presets. Anything missing?

Mike (Eng): Add rollout metrics and thresholds: target token reduction %, P95/P99 latency ceilings, and allowed eval score delta. Need explicit stop conditions.

Linda (ML): Suggest relative quality thresholds per-customer (e.g., recall drop <2%). Avoid brittle metrics; use task-specific evals + spot human checks.

Anna (Solutions): Quick customer mapping: AcmeHealth = accuracy-first, RetailCo = cost-first (30% token reduction target), StartupX = mobile-first. I'll map lanes -> win conditions.

Tom (SRE): Operational recipe: canary 5% -> 25% over 24h, rollback if eval-alert rate > 2% or P99 delta > 50ms. Also add small chaos KV-cache correctness test.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot created epic RDW-1423 and linked PRD https://redwood.internal/epics/RDW-1423 :rocket:

Sasha (PM): Next steps: Mike+Linda draft tech spec with perf targets and bench plan by Tue EOD. Anna owns customer impact matrix. Tom authors SLO guardrails + rollout recipe. Prioritization workshop Wed 10am. :calendar:

Mike (Eng): I'll run an experiment: q4a quant + prefix caching on 10% traffic first.

Linda (ML): Benchmark snippet I'm starting with: ```bash
python bench.py --model llm-2 --quant q4 --seq 512 --batch 1 --iters 100
```

Anna (Solutions): I'll collect customer reps for Wed and attach asks to the matrix.

Tom (SRE): I'll build dashboards (per-route token cost, P95/P99, eval-alert count) and a brief runbook with automated rollback steps.

Sasha (PM): Keep notes here if blockers. Aim for no more than 4 launch gates so sales can set expectations. :+1:
